Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Jeju hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the October 10, 2026 snapshot, at 9 of the 15 Jeju hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Booking.com at 2, klook at 2, Priceline at 2, Agoda at 1, Bluepillow.com at 1 and Trip.com at 1. Taxes and fees at Jeju hotels

At the 11 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 10% ($4 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 8% at Romantic Bed and Breakfast Jeju to 12% at Shalom Hotel Jeju. At 3 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
